pages.text: Amethyst seems to hear its distant kin.$(br2)$(l)Insert an Amethyst Shard$() and place the resonator beside a reservoir. Tune it, then another resonator with a shard inside. Your first branch is joined.

pages.title: Extend the Path
pages.text: Continue along the path, linking each new resonator from one already connected. $(l)More Amethyst Shards$() carry the resonance farther and widen its flow.$(br2)For a distant destination, add another relay. Sneak-tune a connected resonator to release its old route.
